meta.title: Smart Battery Pilot – home battery optimizer for Home Assistant
meta.description: A free Home Assistant integration that plans your home battery a day ahead from dynamic electricity prices, your own consumption and the PV forecast: charge in the cheap hours, cover the expensive ones. Works with any inverter you can script.
meta.og_title: Smart Battery Pilot for Home Assistant
meta.og_description: Charge your home battery in the cheap hours and cover the expensive ones, planned a day ahead inside Home Assistant.

hero.title: Charge in the cheap hours. Cover the expensive ones.
hero.lede: Smart Battery Pilot is a Home Assistant integration that plans your home battery 24 to 36 hours ahead, from your dynamic tariff, your household’s own consumption and the PV forecast. It drives any inverter you can control with a script.

board.title: An example winter day
board.subtitle: 96 quarter-hour prices in EUR/kWh, each coloured by what the pilot does in that slot
board.hint: Point at a bar, or focus the chart and use the arrow keys, to read one slot.
board.chart_label: Example winter day: prices around 0.10 EUR/kWh at night, a morning peak near 0.45, about 0.20 through the day and an evening peak near 0.50. The pilot charges from 02:00 to 06:00, the battery covers 06:00 to 09:00 and 17:00 to 21:00, and the charge is held from 09:00 to 17:00; the inverter runs on its own before 02:00 and after 21:00.
board.sum: A kWh charged at night for 0.10, divided by 90 % round-trip efficiency, plus a 0.10 spread, costs 0.21. That is well under the 0.50 evening peak, so the night is worth storing. The day at 0.20 is not worth spending the battery on, so the charge waits.

plans.title: One planner, every season
plans.lede: Every 30 minutes, and whenever new prices arrive, the pilot plans the next 24 to 36 hours: the cheapest slots charge, the most expensive ones are covered from the battery, and the hours in between keep the energy for later. The same inputs always give the same plan.

winter.title: Winter arbitrage
winter.text: Night power at 0.10, peaks at 0.45 and 0.50. The battery fills before dawn, covers the morning, waits through the day at 0.20 and empties into the evening peak.

summer.title: Summer PV export
summer.text: The roof fills the battery by noon, so the pilot leaves charging to the sun. With export mode on, the evening peak is sold to the grid.

dunkelflaute.title: Dunkelflaute
dunkelflaute.text: Dark, still weeks bring the widest spreads. An eightfold price swing within one day makes grid charging pay for itself, even after conversion losses.

card.title: The plan on your dashboard
card.lede: A Lovelace card ships with the integration: planned actions, price, consumption and state of charge in one view, with three layouts from a phone column to a wall panel.

steps.title: Six steps behind every plan
steps.lede: From the price list to the money it made, in the order the pilot runs them.

price.title: Price forecast
price.text: Reads the price entity of your tariff integration: 15-minute or hourly slots, today and tomorrow.

consumption.title: Consumption forecast
consumption.text: A small model trained daily on your own history: hour, weekday and, with a heat pump, outdoor temperature.

pv.title: PV forecast
pv.text: Expected solar production comes off the demand, and surplus refills the battery in the simulation.

optimisation.title: Optimisation
optimisation.text: Pairs the cheapest charge slots with the most expensive hours, within capacity, power, SOC limits and efficiency.

execution.title: Execution
execution.text: At each slot boundary it calls your scripts: charge, block discharge, auto or export.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.text: From your battery meters it reports what the battery is worth and, separately, what the pilot added.

features.title: Careful with your battery, honest about the money
features.lede: Vendor neutral: the pilot drives your inverter through Home Assistant scripts you write, so it works with any battery Home Assistant can control.

consumption.title: Learns your consumption
consumption.text: Trained daily on your history, aware of weekdays, temperature and heat pumps.

pv.title: Uses the PV forecast
pv.text: Will not lock the battery on a day the sun refills it anyway.

car.title: Plans around your car
car.text: Sessions evcc has planned show up ahead of time, and the battery can stay out of the car.

reserve.title: Backup reserve
reserve.text: A floor arbitrage never spends, refilled by a deadline after an outage.

cold.title: Cold-weather charging
cold.text: Plans with the charge power a cold battery really accepts, and learns it.

numbers.title: Two honest numbers
numbers.text: What the battery is worth, and what the pilot added on top.

safe.title: Safe by default
safe.text: Installs switched off and in dry-run. A missing price or SOC hands the battery back to auto.

languages.title: Ten languages
languages.text: English, German, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian.

features.any_inverter: any inverter Home Assistant can control

install.title: Install from HACS
install.lede: Smart Battery Pilot is in the HACS default repository, so there is no custom repository to add. It installs switched off and in dry-run: the first days are a plan to read, nothing more.
install.download: Search for Smart Battery Pilot in HACS, download it and restart Home Assistant.
install.add_detail: Pick your price sensor, battery, control scripts, consumption meter and PV forecast.
install.card: Put the card on a dashboard.
install.card_detail: Switch the pilot on once the plan makes sense to you.
